## Import libraries

```{r}
#| include: false

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

figure_output <- paste0(getwd(), "/figures")
```

## Mouse Retinas

### Load data

```{r}
#| include: false

seu_obj_mm <- readRDS(paste0("processed_dataset/MmRetina_filtered_integrated.rds"))
```

### Plots

Feature plot output: 1500px \* 900px

```{r}
cells_coexp <- WhichCells(seu_obj_mm, expression = Pou4f2 > 0 & Thrb > 0 & Lhx1 > 0)
DimPlot(seu_obj_mm, reduction = "umap.cca", cells.highlight = cells_coexp, order = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(expression("Pou4f2"^"+"~"/Thrb"^"+"~"/Lhx1"^"+")) +
  NoLegend() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
ggsave(filename = "f5b.tiff", path = figure_output, width = 1500, height = 900, units = "px", dpi = 300)
```
